---
title: "Cytometry In Bioconductor"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(xml2)
library(rvest)
```

```{r}
url <- "https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/BiocViews.html#___FlowCytometry"
```

```{r}
Page <- read_html(url)

body <- Page |> html_element("body")
main_node <- Page |> html_element("main")

section_node <- main_node |> html_element("section.content")
tree_outer <- section_node |> html_element("#tree_outer")
first_node <- html_children(tree_outer)[[2]]

#packages_div <- html_node(tree_outer, "div#packages")
```

```{r}
library(rvest)

# View the HTML inside the node
html_text(packages_div)   # just the text content
html_nodes(packages_div, "*")  # all child nodes
html_children(packages_div)    # direct children

```
